reason: The plugin is primarily a monitoring and runtime control interface for DeepSeek Harness sessions: it continuously evaluates reasoning-text patterns, renders a live visualization panel, and can optionally trigger configurable interventions to influence session flow. Evidence from the repository and readme also shows it runs as a local monitor process with API access, event streaming, and experiment logging/calibration tools, confirming a notification/monitoring-first posture rather than development tooling or content generation.

summaries.zh: 该插件是 DeepSeek Harness 的实时思维链监控插件，在侧边栏展示推理状态可视化，并可按配置在会话中触发提示、重置或重启相关的干预动作。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that provides real-time chain-of-thought monitoring with live visualization and optional configurable session interventions such as hints, resets, and restart guidance.

capabilities: Real-time monitoring of model reasoning text and visible text streams
Three-band fingerprint state tracking (spec/mixed/react) with live streaming visualization
Configurable automated interventions (hint/reset/restart) during active sessions
Web UI panel/sidebar interaction for enabling/disabling interventions and viewing session state
Local monitor process with loopback API endpoints and SSE event stream
Experiment logging (JSONL) with replay and calibration tooling

reasons.code: Plugin purpose is explicitly a real-time chain-of-thought monitor with intervention logic

Plugin includes a CLI/bin entry and standalone monitor process, indicating runtime execution surface
